basic_info.description: Charming 2-Bedroom, 2-Bath Home in the Heart of the Mission District.Welcome to your sunny sanctuary in the vibrant Mission District! This beautifully maintained 2-bedroom, 2-bath property offers the perfect blend of comfort and convenience, making it an ideal home for anyone looking to enjoy the best of San Francisco.  Nestled in a dog-friendly neighborhood, you'll love the picturesque walks with your furry friend along flower-lined streets that greet you with delightful scents each day. The home is thoughtfully secured with gated doors and windows, providing peace of mind without sacrificing style. Inside, you'll find a spacious open-concept kitchen and living area that's perfect for family gatherings and entertaining friends. The large windows invite an abundance of natural light, creating a warm and inviting atmosphere throughout the day. Location is everything, and this property truly delivers. With the freeway just five minutes away, you're never far from the action. Whether you need to commute or explore the city, getting around is a breeze. San Francisco General Hospital is just three minutes away, ensuring peace of mind for your healthcare needs. Living in the Mission District means being at the epicenter of culture, cuisine, and community. Don't miss this opportunity!!!
